# ProgressBar

Stage progress as a white track filled with green hatching; when a stage stalls, the leading 14px turns to red hatching.

`SparkInternals.ProgressBar` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SparkInternals.ProgressBar value={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SparkInternals.ProgressBar" value="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
